item.title: Fortress Mode Now Has Audio(!!) + Myth & Magic progress 🎶 Patch 53.17
item.description: Hey Urists,We wanted to update you on the progress of Myth & Magic. We were hoping to have the update out by the end of the year but unfortunately we won’t be able to reach that goal. Tarn has run into significant issues with the graphics engine and myth generation and we want to take the time to do it right. There is also an update to the graphics engine in progress which will allow us to include all the special magical effects the artists have been working on. We will be sharing progress as we go along and we’ll have a release date when we get closer.Myth & Magic Progress There’s been a good amount of progress to Myth & Magic already! We’ve got new wizard equipment in a variety of different styles. Wizards will come to your fort if your dwarves are able to entice them.
